content.text: Prerequisite: com.thumble.consoleportartworkqa simulator app open in LandscapeRight, Fuskotargar ConsolePort layout received automatically from the real Local Test Receiver, unlimited access active and neutral input. WoW foreground in Valley of Trials outside combat. Coordinates use the simulator AX orientation. This fragment tests the actual exported character labels, not a fixture or generated controller.
[1] ✓ Base must show Heroic Strike. LT must clear the spell slots and show Target Scan Enemy; releasing restores Heroic Strike. Raw Down/Up preserves the held finger across checks.
